outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Professional Services Contract - Museum of Children's Arts - Horace Mann Elementary School

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $23,400 for Museum of Children's Arts lessons at East Oakland Pride Elementary
enrichment.summary: Museum of Children's Arts will provide a teaching artist who will teach 18 art lessons in each of 15 classrooms at East Oakland Pride Elementary School. The contract runs from August 12, 2019 through May 28, 2020. The contract period began before this vote.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Professional Services Contract - Museum of Children's Arts - East Oakland Pride Elementary School

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $12,450 for Flourish Agenda to guide a district leadership development plan
enrichment.summary: Flourish Agenda will plan and run a process that brings district leaders and partners together to design a leadership development framework and recommendations for putting it into practice. The contract runs from September 30, 2019 through November 29, 2019. The contract period began before this vote.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Professional Services Contract - Flourish Agenda - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $15,000 for Joined Path Consulting to train teachers in puberty and sexual health education
enrichment.summary: Joined Path Consulting will lead one-day training for new 6th grade, 7th grade and 9th grade teachers on teaching puberty and sexual health education, plus two evening sessions for 9th grade teachers. The contract runs from October 21, 2019 through May 29, 2020. The contract period began before this vote.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Professional Services Contract - Joined Path Consulting - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $5,330 for Jewish Family & Community Services early childhood specialist at a family center
enrichment.summary: Jewish Family & Community Services will provide a bilingual early childhood developmental specialist to support families, caregivers and parent leaders in the Central Family Resource Center playgroup for children ages zero to five. The contract runs from September 20, 2019 through December 30, 2019. The contract period began before this vote.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Professional Services Contract - Jewish Family & Community Services - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Approves a no-cost agreement with Educational Testing Service for high school equivalency testing
enrichment.summary: Educational Testing Service will provide high school equivalency (HiSET) testing services through the district's Adult and Career Education Department at no cost to the district. It runs from July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020 and renews each year along with ETS's agreement with the state. The contract period began before this vote.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: High School Equivalency Agreement - Educational Testing Service - Adult and Career Education Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $13,500 for an individual contractor to check in with about 25 students
enrichment.summary: An individual contractor will provide check-ins and in-class support for a caseload of about 25 students, with a week of evaluation and goal setting for each student, through the Community Schools and Student Services Department. The contract runs from August 26, 2019 through May 29, 2020. The contract period began before this vote.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Professional Services Contract - Shelvie Mabrey - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $8,000 for Wright Institute clinicians to provide mental health care at Urban Promise
enrichment.summary: Wright Institute will provide a team of graduate student clinicians and one site supervisor for individual and group counseling, teacher and staff consultation, and other psychological services for high-needs students at Urban Promise Academy. The contract runs from July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020. The contract period began before this vote.

items.fundingSource: Unrestricted Supplemental Support and General Purpose-unrestricted

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Professional Services Contract - Wright Institute - Urban Promise Academy

enrichment.headline: Pays Niroga Institute up to $65,000 for weekly mindfulness coaching at five middle schools
enrichment.summary: Niroga Institute, an Oakland nonprofit-style provider, will place a mindfulness coach at five middle schools one day a week for the rest of the 2019-20 school year. The coach uses the Dynamic Mindfulness program, customized to each school's needs. The contract started October 14, 2019, before the Board's ratification vote, and the cost is capped at $65,000.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Professional Services Contract - Niroga Institute - Middle School Network

enrichment.headline: Pays Precita Eyes up to $5,000 to lead students in designing a mural at Oakland High
enrichment.summary: Precita Eyes, a San Francisco organization, will work with Oakland High School students on a community-focused design process. The result will be a mural on the school's sidewalk retaining wall on Park Boulevard. The contract runs August 12, 2019 to May 29, 2020 and is capped at $5,000; the Board is ratifying work already under way.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Professional Services Contract - Precita Eyes - Oakland High School

enrichment.headline: Accepts a $450,000 NoVo Foundation grant to advance social and emotional learning in Oakland schools
enrichment.summary: The district is accepting a $450,000 grant from the NoVo Foundation for a project called "Advancing Social and Emotional Learning in Oakland Schools: Network by Network." The grant period runs from August 1, 2019 through August 1, 2022. The money comes into the district rather than being spent from its budget.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Grant Award - NoVo Foundation - Social and Emotional Learning Department

enrichment.headline: Accepts a California Department of Education tobacco-prevention youth engagement grant
enrichment.summary: The district accepts a Youth Engagement to Address Tobacco Related Health Disparities grant of $250,000 from the California Department of Education for its Tobacco Use Prevention Education program, serving 11 middle and high school sites. The attached grant award covers July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020. The agenda text misprints the amount as "$250,00.00" and gives a 2018 start date.

items.fundingSource: Youth Engagement to Address Tobacco Related Health Disparities Grant

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.sourceIssue: The grant amount is printed as "$250,00.00" and the period as starting July 1, 2018; the attached grant award shows $250,000.00 for July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020.
items.title: Grant Award - California Department of Education - Youth Engagement to Address Tobacco Related Health Disparities Grant - Tobacco Use Prevention Education (TUPE) Program - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Approves Oakland High boys basketball trip to Portland, Oregon at no cost to the district
enrichment.summary: The Board is approving out-of-state travel for sixteen Oakland High School boys basketball players in grades 9 through 12 and four adults. The group will travel to Cleveland High School in Portland, Oregon from December 4 to December 8, 2019 to play two basketball games and attend a Portland Trail Blazers game. The trip costs the district nothing.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Student Travel - Portland, Oregon - Oakland High School

enrichment.headline: Pays a consultant up to $78,000 to support district strategic planning through June 2020
enrichment.summary: A consultant based in Villa Park, CA will review district plans, refine metrics, publish an updated Strategic Plan by the end of the 2019-20 school year, and help draft the communications plan. The consultant will also provide direct support to the Superintendent and senior leadership. The contract runs November 1, 2019 to June 30, 2020 and is capped at $78,000.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Professional Services Contract - Tommy Chang - Office of the Chief of Staff

enrichment.headline: Leases Sherman campus classrooms to Urban Montessori Charter for $77,352.66 in 2019-20
enrichment.summary: Under Proposition 39, the state law on charter school facilities, the district will let Urban Montessori, a charter school, use classrooms at the Sherman campus on Brann Street for the 2019-20 school year. The charter serves grades TK to 3, and the agreement covers one year only. The district will receive $77,352.66.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Proposition 39 Facility Use Agreement - Urban Montessori Charter School - [Sherman Elementary School (In Part)] - 2019-2020 School Year
